classification.difficultyReason: Transfer a corresponding angle through three parallels and combine it with a supplementary coefficient-labelled angle.

spec.description: Three descending parallel lines intersect one rising transversal. Matching single arrowheads occur on all three parallel lines. The upper intersection has a right-hand angle x; the lowest has an upper angle 3x. Neither label has a degree symbol.
spec.mathematics: The corresponding angle to x at the lowest intersection is supplementary to 3x.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown labels only; supplied x = 45° belongs to the answer.

answer.worked:
Corresponding angles on parallel lines are equal. At the lowest intersection, angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}x+3x&=180\\4x&=180\\x&=45^\circ\end{align*}$$
